title: Area Business Manager, Oncology, Rockford, IL - Peoria, IL (East Chicago suburbs)
description: Job title: Area Business Manager, Oncology, Rockford, IL - Peoria, IL (East Chicago suburbs)Location: Remote, US (Geography: Rockford, IL - Peoria, IL - East Chicago suburbs)About the JobThe Oncology Area Business Manager (ABM) is accountable for achieving annual sales objectives for a defined territory through the development, maintenance and enhancement of key customer relationships. Responsibilities include development and implementation of effective territory planning and leveraging Sanofi Genzyme resources effectively. Utilization of effective selling techniques and marketing strategies to create and expand product understanding and appropriate patient identification are also a must.Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs. About Sanofi We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.  Main ResponsibilitiesDevelop and utilize a business plan aligned with marketing strategies through territory analysis, cross-functional collaboration and customer insights (updated quarterly).Implement business plans through leveraging all appropriate resources, both human and physical, with Hematologists and Oncologists and other appropriate key customers.Develop as a product, disease state and marketplace expert.Effectively communicate and position product information to customers in order to successfully promote the appropriate use of the Sanofi Genzyme oncology portfolio within territory.Work closely with all field partners, including, but not limited to Oncology Transplant Network Manager (ONM) as necessary to ensure strategy pull through from Key IDNs/System, Reimbursement, Account, other Sanofi-Genzyme ABMs and Medical (as appropriate).Complete call reporting, business plan updates and expense reports, and operate within all Pharma compliance guidelines.Effective account targeting and time management.Attend training sessions as required and conventions and symposia, as necessary.Complete all fleet safety training and maintain an acceptable driving record regarding accidents and incidents.Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited school required.2+ years of sales experience in pharma, healthcare, biotech or medical devices. Preferred Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in life sciences preferred2 + years of Oncology/Hematology sales experience OR one-year previous Sanofi Oncology/Transplant sales experienceAbility to think, plan, and act strategicallyEffective oral and written communication skills2 years successful experience in the sale of chemotherapeutic agents or bio-tech products preferredWorking knowledge of and familiarity with the hospital and cancer center environment preferred.Driving a company car in a safe manner to daily meetings and appointments is required Why Choose Us?  Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave. Sanofi Inc. and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity employers committed to a culturally inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status; domestic violence victim status; atypical cellular or blood trait; genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing) or any other characteristic protected by law. #GD-SG #LI-GZ#LI-Remote#vhdAll compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience. title: [A&V] RWE Senior Manager,  Analytics Expert
description:
Primary Function

Source, interpret, generate, and communicate high-quality, timely real-world evidence and insights to inform business decisions across therapeutic areas and serve as an RWE expert in engagements with external stakeholders.
§  Lead RWD analyses and collaborate with key stakeholders across global, regional, and Japan-based functions, as well as external partners, to develop, maintain, and appropriately use Japan-relevant RWD assets and analytical environments.

§  Lead the evaluation and implementation of innovative data sources and advanced analytical approaches, including artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), where appropriate.

 

Main Responsibilities

§  Design and execute RWE research projects that address relevant medical and business questions. Develop study protocols, case report forms, questionnaires, statistical analysis plans, and study reports, as applicable. Projects may include patient-reported outcome studies, retrospective and prospective observational studies, and analyses that provide evidence inputs for health economic evaluations to demonstrate the value of Pfizer products.

§  Lead the sourcing, interpretation, and generation of RWE to support internal decision-making and appropriate external scientific communication. Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Marketing, Digital, Policy, and other relevant stakeholders in Japan and globally to develop and apply evidence that supports the value of Pfizer products.

§  Lead and conduct analyses for RWD projects, ensuring appropriate quality assurance and quality control throughout the project lifecycle.

Provide RWD methodological and technical expertise, consultation, and training to relevant colleagues. Develop and review materials for Access & Value, Medical Affairs, Marketing and other stakeholders from an RWE technical perspective, and present evidence to external stakeholders when appropriate.
Ensure that all activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, corporate policies, procedures, and quality standards.

Experience & Background

　Mandatory

§  Masters’s degree or higher in public health, epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

§  Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Japanese

§  Strong programming skills and knowledge of data management and extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes for large-scale RWD

§  Demonstrated ability to analyze RWD using appropriate advanced methods, with knowledge of AI and ML approaches

§  Demonstrated leadership and ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams

§  Scientific rigor combined with a clear understanding of business needs

§  Experience authoring publications in peer-reviewed scientific or medical journals

 

　Preferred

§  PhD in epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, data science, or a related discipline

§  Advanced knowledge of, or practical experience in, statistics, epidemiology, and AI/ML

§  Experience analyzing RWD from claims databases, electronic health records, registries, or other large epidemiological or clinical datasets

 

Competency Required:

§  Innovative and creative thinking

§  Teamwork, networking, and interpersonal skills

§  Ability to engage external stakeholders and contribute to shaping the external environment

§  Results orientation

§  Initiative

§  Adaptability  

§  Ability to translate organizational vision and strategy into action

 

  
Work Location Assignment: On Premise

title: [A&V] Senior Manager, Business Development
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

At Pfizer, we believe that every role contributes to our mission of improving patients' lives. Our business development and strategic planning serve as our corporate representative in crucial negotiations, enabling us to deliver breakthroughs that transform patients' lives. We seek dedicated colleagues who can tackle challenges head-on and devise innovative solutions to fulfill our mission. Your role is vital in navigating important discussions that impact our ability to achieve significant advancements in healthcare.

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will:

Independently identify, evaluate, and drive new business opportunities including partnerships, licensing (in/out), acquisitions, and divestitures.
Lead end-to-end deal processes including evaluation, valuation, negotiation, due diligence, contracting, and post-deal alliance management.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams to assess strategic fit, feasibility, and business rationale.
Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market dynamics to inform BD strategy and opportunity creation.
Manage multiple BD projects concurrently with high autonomy in a fast-paced, lean organizational setting.
Represent Pfizer as a credible counterpart in external partner discussions and negotiations.
Support the BD Lead in shaping and executing Pfizer Japan’s BD strategy and long-term growth initiatives.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in business development in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry.
Proven track record of independently leading BD deals through successful closure.
Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
Experience working cross-functionally.
Deep understanding of the Japanese pharmaceutical industry and regulatory environment.
Solid understanding of deal structures, contracts, and negotiations.
Fluency in both Japanese and English.
High sense of confidentiality and ethics.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

MBA or advanced degree.
Experience working in a global matrix organization.
Experience in alliance management or post-deal integration.
Strong project management and problem-solving capabilities.
Flexibility, adaptability, and ability to manage ambiguity.
Proven ability to engage directly and effectively with senior stakeholders, both internally and externally.
  

  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
